name: xomtra
description: History, catalog and findings of your Home Assistant, from your xomtra server in the LAN.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to a xomtra server on your local network. Issue a personal token in the xomtra admin GUI (Tokens) and enter it here. xomtra only reads data and never changes anything in Home Assistant; Claude gets read-only tools over xomtra's own copy of the data, not access to controlling your home.

url.title: xomtra address
url.description: MCP endpoint of your xomtra server, e.g. https://xomtra.lan/mcp

token.title: Personal token
token.description: Token from the xomtra admin GUI (Tokens), starts with xmt_

ca_file.title: Certificate of the server (optional)
ca_file.description: Needed with xomtra's own certificate (the default in your LAN) unless it is trusted by the system: xomtra-ca.crt from https://<server>/xomtra-ca.crt

allow_http.title: Allow unencrypted http://
allow_http.description: Only for a server on a trusted network without HTTPS
